problem_text: A student first asked AI Chat for room decorating suggestions using only a text description, then asked again after adding a photo of the room. What would you expect to happen to AI's response?

solution.option: The response stays exactly the same regardless of input type.
AI ignores the photo and responds only to the text.
AI's response becomes more specific and tailored to the details visible in the photo.
AI refuses to answer once an image is added.
